name: LCW Evo Championship
epitaph: Founded as the "neo Title" the day LCW split in two, and renamed for the wing's own name change from neo to Evo. Rook Black carried it from the split itself through the winter, until Duel choked him out — the Dawning video package's own words call it an "Evo Title match," oddly, rather than naming the belt outright, which is quoted rather than resolved. By Dawning, Doctor David Chambers held it, and kept it there through the wing's own last captured shows, surviving Dean Wallace's grudge and fending off a fresh challenge from Michael Gabrielle before the record runs out.

name: LCW Evo Madhouse Championship
notes: LCW's own Hardcore Championship, retitled the Madhouse Championship the moment Evo (then neo) split off with it — see the sibling lcw-mercury wing's own tier-3 pass, which independently confirms Mercury kept the tag titles while Evo took the Hardcore/Madhouse lineage.
epitaph: LCW's own Hardcore Championship, carried into the split and renamed the moment neo opened. Duel held it from the very first day, defending it through the winter of 2001-02 against Gryfon and, on a card whose own results were never captured, Frank Heimdal — until Heimdal finally took it off him in a cage at Dawning, the wing's own second Madhouse Champion.
